title: Breast Cancer Production Identity Manifest v1
description: The first disease-specific Oncology manifest. Resolves the existing canonical 'Breast Cancer' disease created by the Oncology Foundation (PR #45) and adds ONLY source-supported identity knowledge from the NCI cancer-types catalog: one new Tier 4 PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE variant (Ductal Carcinoma In Situ), seven Tier 5 identity concepts, and four explicit, individually-declared applicability mappings. Does not create a universal cancer manifest, does not copy any of this content to another cancer disease, and does not create stage, grade, histology, molecular-subtype, metastatic-destination, symptom, treatment, medication, or prognosis knowledge -- none of that is supported by the approved source for this PR.

required_existing_disease.note: Must already exist from the Oncology Foundation import (PR #45). This importer resolves it by exact name and rejects creating a duplicate; it never creates a new Breast Cancer disease row.

new_variants.name: Ductal Carcinoma In Situ
new_variants.evidence_requirement: Requires patient-record pathology evidence (biopsy/pathology report) before this PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE variant is ever treated as a confirmed patient-specific fact. Diagnosis alone never establishes this variant, and it never by itself establishes invasive disease, stage, or hospice eligibility.

unsupported_variants_not_created.note: The approved source (Cancer-Types-NCI-08.22.2021.pdf) does not define these for Breast Cancer in this PR. None of the following are created:
unsupported_variants_not_created.LATERALITY: not defined by the current source (no left/right/bilateral distinction)
unsupported_variants_not_created.STAGE: not defined by the current source for this PR
unsupported_variants_not_created.GRADE: not defined by the current source for this PR
unsupported_variants_not_created.HISTOLOGY: not defined by the current source for this PR (beyond the approved PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE Ductal Carcinoma In Situ)
unsupported_variants_not_created.MOLECULAR_SUBTYPE: not defined by the current source for this PR
unsupported_variants_not_created.METASTATIC_DESTINATION: not defined by the current source for this PR
unsupported_variants_not_created.CLINICAL_CONTEXT: no such variant dimension exists in the schema; Male Breast Cancer and Pregnancy and Breast Cancer are represented as Tier 5 context concepts instead, never as a manufactured Tier 4 dimension

concepts.name: Breast Cancer
evidence_requirements: documented clinician diagnosis in the patient record
never auto-confirmed from this ontology concept alone
concepts.description: Breast Cancer identity concept from the NCI cancer-types catalog. Authorizes cancer-identity knowledge only; never auto-confirms diagnosis, stage, histology, molecular subtype, treatment, or hospice eligibility.

concepts.name: Ductal Carcinoma In Situ
evidence_requirements: documented pathology evidence in the patient record
never auto-confirmed from this ontology concept alone
never treated as invasive breast cancer
concepts.description: Ductal Carcinoma In Situ identity concept from the NCI cancer-types catalog. Stored separately from, and never collapsed into, invasive Breast Cancer.

concepts.name: Male Breast Cancer
evidence_requirements: documented clinician diagnosis in the patient record
never inferred from any patient sex or gender field
never auto-confirmed from this ontology concept alone
concepts.description: Male Breast Cancer identity concept from the NCI cancer-types catalog. Represents a documented cancer-identity fact only; never infers, sets, or reads patient sex or gender.

concepts.name: Pregnancy and Breast Cancer
evidence_requirements: documented clinician diagnosis in the patient record
never inferred from any current pregnancy status
never auto-confirmed from this ontology concept alone
concepts.description: Pregnancy and Breast Cancer identity concept from the NCI cancer-types catalog. Represents a documented cancer-identity fact only; never infers or asserts current pregnancy.

concepts.name: Localized Breast Cancer
evidence_requirements: documented clinician evidence in the patient record
never asserted from disease diagnosis alone
concepts.description: Foundation-state identity concept applying the Oncology Foundation's Localized Disease state to Breast Cancer specifically.

concepts.name: Metastatic Breast Cancer
evidence_requirements: documented clinician evidence in the patient record
never asserted from disease diagnosis alone
concepts.description: Foundation-state identity concept applying the Oncology Foundation's Metastatic Disease state to Breast Cancer specifically. Never establishes a metastatic destination, which this PR does not create.

concepts.name: Recurrent Breast Cancer
evidence_requirements: documented clinician evidence in the patient record
never asserted from disease diagnosis alone
never automatically equivalent to Metastatic Breast Cancer
concepts.description: Foundation-state identity concept applying the Oncology Foundation's Recurrent Disease state to Breast Cancer specifically. Recurrence alone never automatically means metastatic disease.

unattached_concepts_not_given_applicabil.note: Breast Cancer (base identity), Male Breast Cancer, and Pregnancy and Breast Cancer are intentionally given ZERO applicability edges in this PR. No approved Tier 4 variant dimension exists for 'clinical context' (sex/gender/pregnancy), and manufacturing one, or substituting PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE/LATERALITY/TREATMENT_STATE/PHYSIOLOGICAL_PHENOTYPE for that purpose, is explicitly forbidden.

differentiation_guards.guard_name: Breast Cancer IS_NOT Breast Primary Site
Ductal Carcinoma In Situ IS_NOT Invasive Breast Cancer
Male Breast Cancer DOES_NOT_INFER Patient Sex Or Gender
Pregnancy and Breast Cancer DOES_NOT_INFER Current Pregnancy
Localized Breast Cancer IS_NOT Metastatic Breast Cancer
Recurrent Breast Cancer IS_NOT Automatically Metastatic Breast Cancer
Metastatic Breast Cancer DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH Metastatic Destination
Breast Cancer Diagnosis DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH Hospice Eligibility
Breast Cancer Diagnosis DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH Molecular Subtype
